Container.Name: Bindarr
Container.Overview:
Collection manager for trading cards: Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Disney Lorcana, Riftbound, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Digimon, Flesh and Blood, Star Wars: Unlimited and the Gundam Card Game.
Scan cards with your phone camera, track market prices and value over time, and record which binder page and pocket or box row each card is in. Build decks from what you own, keep wishlists and buylists, and share collections with other accounts on the server.
The first visit to the WebUI creates the admin account and asks for a setup code, which the container log prints while no account exists (or set Setup code below). Card scanning needs a secure context, so phones should use the HTTPS port (a self-signed certificate is generated unless you provide your own) or a reverse proxy with TLS.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Web interface over HTTP. Point a reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: HTTPS port
Config.Description: Web interface over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate unless SSL_CERT_PATH is set. Use this from phones when there is no reverse proxy: camera scanning needs HTTPS.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, backups, TLS certificates, scan models and catalogs.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: External URL when behind a reverse proxy, e.g. https://cards.example.com. Used for share links and allowed as a CORS origin.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy so rate limiting sees the real client IP.

Config.Name: Allow registration
Config.Description: true allows anyone who can reach the server to create an account. Leave empty for invite-only.

Config.Name: HTTPS port inside the container
Config.Description: Set to an empty value to serve plain HTTP only (camera scanning then works only on localhost or behind a TLS proxy).

Config.Name: TLS certificate path
Config.Description: Your own certificate inside the container, e.g. /app/database/certs/fullchain.pem. Leave empty for a self-signed one.

Config.Name: TLS key path
Config.Description: Private key for that certificate, e.g. /app/database/certs/privkey.pem.

Config.Name: Setup code
Config.Description: Code the first visit asks for before creating the admin account. Leave empty for a new random code in the container log on each start.

Config.Name: Default admin password
Config.Description: Create the admin account at startup with this password instead of on first visit.

Config.Name: Allow private notification targets
Config.Description: true lets price alerts reach LAN or Docker hosts, such as a local ntfy.
